verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed https://developer.sumup.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and lists documentation sets, including an abridged llms-small.txt. The docs also state that every page is available as plain-text Markdown by appending index.md, and there is a dedicated section for giving coding assistants current SumUp documentation. Missing for 10: the probe captured only a truncated view of llms.txt, so its full contents are unverified, and there are no independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.sumup.com/llms.txt # SumUp Developer
